mapper.sql: SELECT o.id, o.order_no, o.book_id AS bookId, b.title AS bookTitle, o.buyer_id AS buyerId, COALESCE(bup.nickname, bu.username) AS buyerName, o.seller_id AS sellerId, COALESCE(sup.nickname, su.username) AS sellerName, o.amount, o.trade_type AS tradeTypeCode, CASE o.trade_type WHEN 1 THEN '出售' WHEN 2 THEN '赠送' WHEN 3 THEN '交换' END AS tradeType, o.ship_type AS shipTypeCode, CASE o.ship_type WHEN 1 THEN '邮寄' WHEN 2 THEN '自提' END AS shipType, o.status AS statusCode, CASE o.status WHEN 1 THEN '待支付' WHEN 2 THEN '待发货' WHEN 3 THEN '待收货' WHEN 4 THEN '已完成' WHEN 5 THEN '已取消' WHEN 6 THEN '售后中' END AS statusText, a.receiver_name AS receiverName, a.phone AS receiverPhone, CONCAT(a.province, a.city, a.district, a.detail) AS receiverAddress, o.cancel_reason AS cancelReason, p.pay_status AS payStatus, p.pay_time AS payTime, o.create_time, o.update_time, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trade_evaluation te WHERE te.order_id = o.id AND te.evaluator_id = #{currentUserId}) > 0 AS evaluatedByMe FROM trade_order o JOIN book b ON o.book_id = b.id AND b.deleted = 0 JOIN sys_user bu ON o.buyer_id = bu.id AND bu.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN user_profile bup ON bu.id = bup.user_id AND bup.deleted = 0 JOIN sys_user su ON o.seller_id = su.id AND su.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN user_profile sup ON su.id = sup.user_id AND sup.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN address a ON o.address_id = a.id AND a.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN payment p ON p.order_id = o.id WHERE o.deleted = 0

AND (o.order_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR b.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR bu.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR su.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND o.status = #{status} AND o.trade_type = #{tradeType} ORDER BY o.create_time DESC
